text: The 2025 loss within the asset is not yet confirmed as persistent. While a tree-cover loss of approximately 13.5 hectares was mapped by Hansen/UMD in 2025, this is the latest year of the series. To confirm persistence, a later year of observation is needed. The JRC 2020 reference agrees on 98% of the event area, indicating that the area was forested in 2020. However, without data from subsequent years, we cannot confirm that the loss is permanent. The cause, legality, and responsible actor for the change also remain unknown.
